title: Too early, then ready
text: The transition `send` has `window(200, 1000)`: its clock starts when it is enabled, it may not fire before 200 ms, and it must fire by 1000 ms. The transition `archive` has `delayed(5000)` and no deadline, so it waits five seconds after `sent` is marked and then fires whenever the executor gets to it.

steps.text: The transition `send` is enabled at 0 ms, so its clock starts then. At 100 ms it is armed but too early; at 200 ms its window opens and it fires.
The place `sent` is marked at 200 ms, which arms `archive`. It fires at 5200 ms, five seconds later.
